description: This file contains functions related to installation and upgrade procedures for the Advanced OpenSales module within the SuiteCRM project. It manages configuration settings, version checks, database updates, and file renaming involved in the module's setup and upgrade process.

methods.name: install_aos
methods.description: Initializes default configuration settings for the Advanced OpenSales module and writes them to the configuration file.

methods.name: upgrade_aos
methods.description: Performs version-based upgrade steps for the module, including database updates and file migrations.
